summary: Today and Saturday are the week — light and offshore winds have everything clean, and Ditch Plains is the standout right now with prime-angle chest-high surf and glass all day, worth the drive if you can make it. Rockaway is a perfectly good small glassy log both mornings if you'd rather stay home, and Matunuck offers the most size up in Rhode Island. After Saturday it goes onshore and junky through midweek; the bigger Wed-Thu swell comes in at the wrong angles and blown out, so score it now.
